form_fields.description: Every interactive form field: name, type (text, checkbox, radio, combo, list, button, signature), value, options, page, rect (top-left-origin points) and rotation (0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees counterclockwise), read-only and required flags.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

form_fields.name: form_fields

form_fill.description: Set several fields at once (one undo step). values maps field names (from form_fields) to: a string for text fields, combo boxes and radio groups (an option), true/false for check boxes, an array of strings for multi-select lists. Appearances are regenerated so every viewer shows the values. A value whose characters the field's font can't draw (Chinese in a Helvetica field) is still saved; `warnings` in the result names the field and character: PdfCraft draws `?` there and asks other viewers to redraw the field from its value.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

form_fill.name: form_fill

doc_save.description: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic. flatten_fill_sign bakes Fill & Sign text, marks and signatures into the page first and removes those annotations; other comments and form fields stay. Omit it, or pass false, to leave them editable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

flatten_fill_sign.description: Bake Fill & Sign marks into the page before writing. Default false.

full.description: Force a full rewrite (or, with false, an incremental update).

path.description: Save as this file. Omit to save in place.

doc_save.name: doc_save

page_render.description: Render one page to a PNG image (default 96 dpi, at most 600).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

hide_text_block.description: Render an inline editor background without this paragraph (index from text_paragraphs). Does not modify the document.

page_render.name: page_render
